-- 2025 monthly revenue: running total and change vs previous month
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
    AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT
  month,
  ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(revenue) OVER (), 2) AS running_revenue,
  ROUND(revenue - LEAD(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS mom_change
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month;

WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    strftime('%Y-%m', o.order_date) AS month,
    SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1 - oi.discount)) AS revenue
  FROM orders AS o
  JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    AND o.order_date >= '2025-01-01'
    AND o.order_date < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY month
)
SELECT
  month,
  ROUND(revenue, 2) AS revenue,
  ROUND(SUM(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS running_revenue,
  ROUND(revenue - LAG(revenue) OVER (ORDER BY month), 2) AS mom_change
FROM monthly
ORDER BY month;
